scope: Pass 03 local source implementation and production-build validation; no deployment, live provider or external communication

productionBuild.note: Built-in SQLite emits its documented experimental warning

browserEngine: Playwright Chromium; in-app browser execution tool unavailable
accessibility: Axe WCAG 2.2 AA checks passed on nine routes, mobile navigation/gallery overlays, source option controls, populated mobile checkout and default final review. Not a compliance certification.

humanInspected: final narrow hero and checkout details

sourceAudit.workflow: Public service descriptions and FAQ establish purchase → confirmation → emailed shipping instructions → customer-supplied component → receipt-based lead time. No live cart/order action performed.
uncertainties: Public checkout could not be read without an established live cart; no checkout bypass or order attempt made
Unaudited services, ambiguous modifications/model scope and combined-service pricing remain review-only
Shipping charges, tax rules and live provider eligibility remain unconfigured

orderability: Independent service-price/compatibility readiness (ready/requires-review/invalid), separate from environment payment availability
errorAndSecurityChecks: concurrent request reservation and stable idempotent order number
rapid double clicks execute one client request
server failure retains fields and cart
private confirmation is 404 from a different browser
checkout personal data absent from localStorage
missing communication provider reports not-configured; injected failure reports failed
orderPersistence: Encrypted local SQLite repository, explicitly test-only; version 2 snapshots, atomic payment claim, matching session required
communication: Provider-neutral confirmation/shipping-instructions/status boundaries only. No email sent; shipping instructions pending.

via.title: braces vulnerable to stack-exhaustion denial of service through deeply nested patterns

dependencyAudit.decision: Five inherited development-tooling advisories through braces/micromatch/fast-glob/Next ESLint. No production vulnerabilities. Registry proposed a major Next tooling downgrade, which was not applied.

productionDependencies: Approved payment provider and verified production adapter
Server-side payment verification, transaction identity, webhook/reconciliation and recovery
Complete service/optic option pricing and compatibility matrix
Order notification delivery and fulfillment workflow
Shared durable repository and shared abuse controls
Encryption-key custody, backup/restore and retention/deletion policy
Owner/legal approval of Terms and Privacy
